entries.heading: There is hereby appropriated $1,996,000 to carry out
ancestors: DIVISION A—-AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2014
entries.text:
Sec. 728.  There is hereby appropriated $1,996,000 to carry out 
section 1621 of Public Law 110-246.

entries.heading: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, funds
ancestors: DIVISION E—FINANCIAL SERVICES AND GENERAL GOVERNMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2014
entries.text:
Sec. 728.  Notwithstanding any other provision of law, funds 
appropriated for official travel to Federal departments and agencies may 
be used by such departments and agencies, if consistent with Office of 
Management and Budget Circular A-126 regarding official travel for 
Government personnel, to participate in the fractional aircraft 
ownership pilot program.
